deck_title: Rodrigues SO(3) axis-angle rotation vs naive linear tangent cross-product stretch rig

cards.subtitle: Deterministic Olinde Rodrigues (1840) exact SO(3) exponential-map axis-angle rotation (v_Rod(theta) = v_0 cos(theta) + (k x v_0) sin(theta) + k(k*v_0)(1 - cos(theta)), locking ||v_Rod|| = 1.0000x) versus naive first-order linearized tangent cross-product perturbation (v_naive(theta) = v_0 + theta*(k x v_0), inflating length by the Pythagorean hypotenuse ||v_naive|| = sqrt(1 + theta^2)) and 64-substep Cayley-Pade Lie-group midpoint integration across 17 rotation angle stations (theta in [0.0000, 1.5000] rad).
